description: Generates a simple waveform - a pure generator with NO audio input (input_arity 0; call process() without an input argument). Pinned to submode 1 (sine); submodes 2 (square), 3 and 4 are reachable via execute() - NOTE the banner labels mode 3 'sawtooth' and 4 'ramp', but the rendered mode-3 shape is a TRIANGLE (rise to peak at quarter-cycle, fall through zero to the trough at three-quarter; SoundThread and afta8 both call it triangle - the banner label is wrong). Output duration is set exactly by dur (2.0 -> 88200 frames). Both frq and amp are breakpoint-capable (banner: 'Frq and Amp may vary through time'; both verified against the binary), making this a full envelope-controllable test oscillator. Deterministic (identical runs byte-identical). Peak amplitude at amp 1 is full scale.
musical_use: The reference tone and additive-ish building block: sine sweeps for probing filters and spectral processes (SoundThread ships it as a Distort-testing node), carrier tones for envel impose rhythm transplants, formant targets for formants put, or drones via long dur. Time-varying frq (breakpoint) yields glissandi and sirens - relative times map onto dur, so [[0,220],[1,880]] is a two-octave rise across the whole render regardless of length; time-varying amp shapes the tone without a second enveloping pass. Frequencies above Nyquist are accepted SILENTLY and alias (12 kHz at 22.05 kHz sample rate ran without warning) - keep frq below srate/2 yourself. tabsize trades table resolution (256-4096): the default 256 adds low-level table-interpolation harmonics to a sine - raise to 4096 for a cleaner reference tone. Hot at amp 1; stage headroom before summing (submix mix wraps).

srate.description: Output sample rate - same discrete set as synth noise: 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000 (non-members refused 'Invalid sample rate.'; the quoted range '(16000.000000 to 192000.000000)' and the banner's list are both wrong at the edges). Entry default 44100 - always emitted (positional).

chans.description: Output channel count, CDP-enforced '(1.000000 to 16.000000)' (banner claims 1, 2 or 4; 17 refused with the quoted range). Multi-channel output is DUAL-MONO (channels bit-identical, verified stereo).

dur.description: Output duration in seconds - sets the output length exactly (sample-exact; 0.039 refused '(0.040000 to 7200.000000)'). The engine's own duration cap (default 300 s) applies first via the set_by pre-flight. Required.

frq.description: Oscillator frequency in Hz. CDP-enforced '(0.100000 to 22000.000000)' REGARDLESS of sample rate - above-Nyquist values are accepted silently and alias (12 kHz at srate 22050 verified, no warning). Fractional values fine (440.5). BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: a 440->880 envelope renders and differs from the constant render) - relative envelope times map onto dur. Entry default 440 (positional, always emitted).

amp.description: Output amplitude, CDP-enforced 0-1 (omitted = 1.0, full scale). CDP accepts -a0 but renders digital silence (verification would fail) - curated min keeps it nonzero. BREAKPOINT-CAPABLE (verified: 0->1 ramp, first-100ms RMS ~6% of last). With no audio input, relative-time envelopes compile against the OUTPUT duration (dur).

tabsize.description: Size of the wavetable storing the waveform, CDP-enforced '(256.000000 to 4096.000000)' (-t3 and -t100000 both refused quoting it; afta8's 0-32000 is wrong). Default 256 when omitted; rounded to a multiple of 4. -t4096 verified to change the render (finer table = cleaner tone).

examples.expected_use: No input argument. Byte-identical on every render.
Relative envelope times stretch over the full 6 s; the glissando and the fade both scale with dur.

known_issues: Waveform submodes: 1 sine (pinned), 2 square, 3 triangle, 4 ramp. DIVERGENCE: the banner calls mode 3 'sawtooth wave', but the rendered shape is a triangle (peak at quarter-cycle, trough at three-quarter, verified numerically); afta8 and SoundThread both label it triangle. Other shapes via execute(['synth', 'wave', '<mode>', ...]).
frq's enforced ceiling is a flat 22000 Hz independent of sample rate: above-Nyquist frequencies are accepted SILENTLY and alias (verified 12 kHz at srate 22050). Keep frq < srate/2.
amp 0 is accepted by CDP but renders digital silence (fails output verification) - curated nonzero minimum.
Deterministic: no seed, no clock dependence; identical params render byte-identically. Multi-channel output is dual-mono (channels bit-identical).
srate accepts only the discrete set 16000/22050/24000/32000/44100/48000/88200/96000 despite the quoted 16000-192000 range; tabsize's real range is 256-4096 despite afta8's 0-32000.
A '-f' (float output) flag from third-party docs is accepted and IGNORED (output stays PCM_16) - not exposed.
Generator entry: process() takes no input argument here; graph()/batch()/sweep() refuse arity-0 entries with a structured arity_zero_unsupported error - render first, then wire the output.
